title: Two more runs of the 1RB1RF_1RC1LC table can only halt at the left end
text: 1RB1LB_1LC0LD_---1LD_1RE0LA_0RF1RD_1RA1RE and 1RB0LD_0RC1RA_1RD1RB_1RE1LE_1LF0LA_---1LA are the table of 1RB1RF_1RC1LC_1LD0LE_---1LE_1RF0LB_0RA1RE renamed and started in other states. Its Lean proof that no 00 forms left of the head carries over to both, so each can only halt next to the leftmost 1 of the tape. For 1RB0LD_0RC1RA the halting pattern is new in Lean too.
